origine_fr: La personne 亻 et 申, lu shēn comme 伸, qui donne le son. Il veut dire « étendre », le contraire de plier. Le sens est resté : étendre, tendre, allonger.
origine_en: A person 亻 and 申, read shēn just like 伸, which gives the sound. It means “to stretch”, the opposite of bending. The meaning stayed: to stretch, to extend, to lengthen.

phrase.pinyin: Tā xiàng wǒ shēnchū le shǒu.
phrase.en: He held out his hand to me.
